sections.title: Apportionment of income between spouses governed by Portuguese Civil Code.
sections.text_before_subsections: If a husband and wife are governed by the community of property system (known as "COMMUNIAO DOS BENS" under the Portuguese Civil Code of 1860) in force in the State of Goa and the Union Territories of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu, then—
